carterdelaruelle: After 7 days of war, S-S14 had a place for everything. On Day 7, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Henrik "Lucky" Carterdelaru. The new duty roster listed Henrik "Lucky" Carterdelaru as a sniper. He kept checking the old roster until someone took it down.

Henrik "Lucky" Carterdelaru lay in the ruins of Sorrow Copse from dawn to dusk. He did not fire once. That is also a kind of victory. Mail came up the line with a letter for Henrik "Lucky" Carterdelaru. Henrik "Lucky" Carterdelaru read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Henrik "Lucky" Carterdelaru noticed a loophole that had been dark for days. He watched it until dusk and wrote down what changed.

Henrik "Lucky" Carterdelaru crawled through a gap in the Concord wire and slid into their trench. Bram Eccentricred reached for a rifle. Henrik "Lucky" Carterdelaru was faster with the sharpened shovel. (@eccentricredeye) Henrik "Lucky" Carterdelaru had just lit a cigarette at S-S14 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Norbert "Mud" Leothebeo of the Concord (@leothebeo8). Blackwater Canal has been won. Henrik "Lucky" Carterdelaru listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch. Mail came up the line with a letter for Henrik "Lucky" Carterdelaru. Henrik "Lucky" Carterdelaru read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Machine-gun fire swept S-S14. Henrik "Lucky" Carterdelaru took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Wendel Raymond of the Concord (@raymond216469). Henrik "Lucky" Carterdelaru stood up to fix a loose sandbag at S-S14. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Wendel Raymond of the Concord (@raymond216469).

Florian Carterdelaru put a lock of hair in a matchbox beside the bunk. Someone who had known Henrik "Lucky" Carterdelaru helped clear the shelf without saying why. Florian Carterdelaru got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 483. The men who came later will ask about it. Victory at Grey Mill. Florian Carterdelaru let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Florian Carterdelaru let the enemy fix the same sandbag three times. The fourth time, Rafael Warhamster was grazed.
Florian Carterdelaru and Otto "Brick" Valsteinne made a pact: whoever gets home first visits the other's mother. They shook on it twice, to be sure.
Florian Carterdelaru stacked spare duckboards beside the junction. Within an hour, the stack had become a bench, a table and an argument.

Florian Carterdelaru had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Pavel Sbarp crossed it, Florian Carterdelaru fired. Pavel Sbarp was badly wounded. Florian Carterdelaru took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at S-S14, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Oskar Urfavv of the Concord (@urfavv__j).
Florian Carterdelaru lay on the stretcher and listened to the surgeon working inside. He tried not to guess what each sound meant.
The stretcher Florian Carterdelaru lay on for so long has a dent the shape of a body. Florian Carterdelaru is back at S-S14, and someone else is lying in that dent now.
chamra_universal: On Day 4, Matthias Universal arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions. Orders assigned Matthias Universal to work as a sniper. The first lesson began with what not to touch.

Zeno Irl and Matthias Universal divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion. A letter from home found Matthias Universal before the night shift. Matthias Universal folded it small and kept it close.

A story about a goat passed through three dugouts and reached Matthias Universal as a story about a general. The ending was the same. A letter from home found Matthias Universal before the night shift. Matthias Universal folded it small and kept it close. The Hegemony secured Hill 304. Matthias Universal helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

Matthias Universal fired at a movement across the wire at R-F21. The man went down: Silas Schu, badly wounded. Blast from a trench mortar threw Matthias Universal against the trench wall at R-F21. Ringing ears, a split lip, and no intention of leaving. A letter from home found Matthias Universal before the night shift. Matthias Universal folded it small and kept it close.
The medics cleaned Matthias Universal's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at R-F21.

Matthias Universal lay behind a dead tree trunk at R-F21 for six hours without moving. One shot at dusk. Yann "Brick" Zaza was gravely wounded. A letter from home found Matthias Universal before the night shift. Matthias Universal folded it small and kept it close.

Matthias Universal had watched a loose sandbag in the enemy wall for two days. This morning it moved. Florian "Lucky" Nistico was badly wounded. A letter from home found Matthias Universal before the night shift. Matthias Universal folded it small and kept it close.

Twenty yards of mud, one gap in the wire, one jump. Matthias Universal landed next to Emil "Button" Zaza in the Concord trench. Only Matthias Universal climbed back out. (@tf.is.zaza) Matthias Universal was on watch at R-F21 when the night raid hit. The men found Matthias Universal at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Pavel Hemana of the Concord (@grant.hemana).
Lucien Universal arrived carrying the family name of Matthias Universal. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.

A bullet hit Lucien Universal's belt buckle at R-F21 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Karel "Button" Nikola of the Concord (@zoric_nikola011). The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Lucien Universal answered to number 278. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at R-F21 changed before the cheering ended. Lucien Universal shouldered another load.
The medic looked at Lucien Universal's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to R-F21. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.

Lucien Universal felt a hard tug at his hip at R-F21. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Anselm "Saint" Davis of the Concord (@lucas_davis1775).
Out on the wire with the wiring party. Lucien Universal was hit in the forearm at R-F21. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind.

Lucien Universal's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at R-F21 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on. The snipers took Lucien Universal in on a busy morning in R-F21. By noon he had learned the first rule of the job, and by evening the second.

Lucien Universal jumped into the Concord trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Casimir Danny. The Concord medics will be busy. (@sus.danny2.0) The raid was quick, the way back was not. Lucien Universal snagged on the wire and took a bullet before the others pulled Lucien Universal free. Lucien Universal lies on a stretcher in the communication trench. All day, men step past carrying food and ammunition the other way. A letter for Lucien Universal came with a photograph. Lucien Universal looked at it for a long time and said nothing.
The medics had to choose who got the last bed. They did not choose Lucien Universal. He died on the stretcher before morning.
The papers connected Bastian Universal to Lucien Universal. The men took longer to learn Bastian Universal's own habits, but they made the effort.
colemarkpearson: Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear found a place in R-F15 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.
Benedikt Durham and Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At relief, the next watch was told it had been a good hour.
Verdel Ridge fell to the Concord at dusk. Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear kept watch so that Edmund "Whistle" Es could sleep. Then Whistle kept watch so that Saint could. Neither slept.
Someone had labelled the water bucket 'Soup'. Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear changed it back after lunch, too late to settle the argument.

Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear caught a falling mug with his boot. Nobody could say if it was skill or luck, and he did not say either. The Hegemony hold Hill 304 now, and they can see straight into R-F15. Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear has learned to walk bent double.
Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear tried to write neatly for the first line of a letter. By the third, he was writing as quickly as the thoughts arrived.
A single shot from across the wire hit Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear in the thigh at R-F15. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Nils "Brick" Dilloncoll of the Hegemony (@dilloncoll2015).

A bed came free in the hospital dugout, and Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear was carried in at last. A letter from home found Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear before the night shift. Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear folded it small and kept it close.

The man in the next bed snored all day. Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear did not mind. It meant someone was still breathing. A letter from home found Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear before the night shift. Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear folded it small and kept it close.

Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear rejoined R-F15 carrying a borrowed book from the ward. It is now overdue, which he says is a good reason to stay alive. Blackwater Canal is lost. Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Gideon Green was grazed at the far edge of no man's land. A letter from home found Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear before the night shift. Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear folded it small and kept it close. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear is number 120. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear wrote to a sweetheart who has stopped writing that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear and Benedikt Durham have a secret signal: two taps on the helmet means 'still here'. They use it every night after the flares go out. A letter from home found Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear before the night shift. Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear folded it small and kept it close.

Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear turned a year older today. The whole squad sang for him, badly, and the cook found a candle. A letter from home found Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear before the night shift. Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear folded it small and kept it close.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at R-F15 is up. Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Tobias Dilloncoll was grazed. Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear ate breakfast without a word. A letter from home found Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear before the night shift. Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear folded it small and kept it close.

Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear fixed the bayonet, then thought better of it and fired instead. Across the wire, Tobias Dilloncoll was gravely wounded. A letter from home found Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear before the night shift. Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear folded it small and kept it close.

Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear counted the steps of the Hegemony sentry, waited for the turn, and went in. Clement Wanter never saw the shovel coming. (@wanter_cz) Twenty yards of mud, one gap in the wire, one jump. Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear landed next to Anselm Brunoescobar in the Hegemony trench. Only Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear climbed back out. (@brunoescobar36) The squad counted heads when the raiders came back. Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear was missing. At dawn they saw Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear lying by the wire. Killed in the night raid by Florian Ebrrrvole of the Hegemony (@ebrrrvole).
Marek Colemarkpear had heard about Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear's courage. At R-F15, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.

A round came through the loophole Marek Colemarkpear was watching at R-F15 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Isidor Serrano of the Hegemony (@ana_serrano_7). The whole squad at R-F15 fired five rounds rapid. The squad agrees it was Marek Colemarkpear's bullet that found Konrad Jngaf, grazed.
da_r3al_squid1: Anselm "Brick" Squid came up on Day 9 carrying news from Greyhallow. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Anselm "Brick" Squid kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

Anselm "Brick" Squid shaved using a spoon for a mirror. One side looks ready for inspection. The other looks ready for winter. The clerk counted the names twice. Anselm "Brick" Squid is number 649 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In S-C9, Anselm "Brick" Squid listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Pavel Unoffical and Anselm "Brick" Squid tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco.
Matthias "Saint" Mulletoperat of the Hegemony shouted a joke across the wire at the Drowned Farm. Anselm "Brick" Squid of the Concord laughed before remembering not to. Both lines heard it.
Anselm "Brick" Squid snores. Marek "Doc" Dizickkumer does not. Doc now sleeps with a sock stuffed in each ear, and the two are still friends.
Anselm "Brick" Squid saw Dietrich "Button" Cake freeze up on the fire step at the Brickworks. Brick said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough.
A shell splinter the size of a fist hit Anselm "Brick" Squid at S-C9. He is alive and he is in pain, and he needs a bed.
Anselm "Brick" Squid lay on the stretcher and listened to the surgeon working inside. He tried not to guess what each sound meant.
dylansteele71: Ivo "Mole" Dylansteele arrived with the Day 9 draft, carrying a bullet that missed him and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.
From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Ivo "Mole" Dylansteele wrote to a younger sister who sends drawings that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Ivo "Mole" Dylansteele across the shin at S-C1. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Leopold Shallowcrow of the Hegemony (@shallowcrow114). Ivo "Mole" Dylansteele got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 759. The men who came later will ask about it. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Ivo "Mole" Dylansteele looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
Back on the fire step at S-C1. Ivo "Mole" Dylansteele says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign.
The cook asked for an honest opinion of the stew. Ivo "Mole" Dylansteele asked if second helpings depended on the answer.
Ivo "Mole" Dylansteele found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'.
Ivo "Mole" Dylansteele fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Dietrich "Button" Slade, now badly wounded.
The Hegemony sentry, Benedikt "Mole" Twenskyyy, shouted once. Ivo "Mole" Dylansteele silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@twenskyyy)
The last report placed Ivo "Mole" Dylansteele near the Chalk Pits. By evening, no later report had arrived. Missing.
el_tiburoncito: On Day 9, Ulrich "Ash" Tiburoncito arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.

A bullet hit Ulrich "Ash" Tiburoncito in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at S-R16. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Wendel Raymond of the Concord (@raymond216469). The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Blackwater Canal. Ulrich "Ash" Tiburoncito folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

No bed for Ulrich "Ash" Tiburoncito yet. A medic checked the bandage and promised him a place as soon as one opened up. Grey Mill has been won. Ulrich "Ash" Tiburoncito listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Ulrich "Ash" Tiburoncito spent a week on a stretcher in the corridor of the aid post. Today he stood up, held the wall, and walked out to S-R16.
Oskar Rykerfallion and Ulrich "Ash" Tiburoncito sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour.
Ulrich "Ash" Tiburoncito polished a spoon until he could see a small, bent version of his face. It looked unimpressed with supper too.
Ulrich "Ash" Tiburoncito saved a seat for someone fetching supper. Holding it against three hungry men turned out to be hard work.

Ulrich "Ash" Tiburoncito felt a hard tug at his hip at S-R16. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Tobias "Brick" Blakeg of the Concord (@blakeg.p11).
Ulrich "Ash" Tiburoncito's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
franco_vinsaint: Pavel Vinsaint found a place in N-F20 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.
Yann Ootrumhellfi and Pavel Vinsaint share one pair of good gloves on watch, one glove each. It is not practical. It is friendship.
Pavel Vinsaint brushed dried mud off a letter and found one more word under it: 'soon'. He wished the rest of the sentence had survived.
Clement "Mud" Sporkus and Pavel Vinsaint tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco.
Someone asked Pavel Vinsaint to wake them in ten minutes. He had no watch, so he counted slowly and woke them at what felt like ten.
Pavel Vinsaint saved the last of the sugar for Yann Ootrumhellfi's birthday. Nobody knows if it really was Yann's birthday. It was a good day anyway.
glubtupuswheple: Clement Glubtupuswhe came up with a draft of replacements on Day 9. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it. Clement Glubtupuswhe reported for duty as a chaplain. The new kit was heavier than the explanation of how to use it.
Blackwater Canal is lost. Clement Glubtupuswhe heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

Clement Glubtupuswhe was found at the bottom of the trench at R-R8, hit in the head, helmet split open. He is breathing in short, loud gasps. Shot by Dorian Yoollyfox of the Hegemony (@yoollyfox). A man in the hospital dugout died before dawn, and his bed went to Clement Glubtupuswhe. Nobody pretends that is not how it works. Clement Glubtupuswhe is out of danger. Still bedridden, still bandaged, but out of danger. A letter from home reached Clement Glubtupuswhe before dusk. Clement Glubtupuswhe read it twice and slept a little easier. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Clement Glubtupuswhe is number 828. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Clement Glubtupuswhe watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Clement Glubtupuswhe drifted in and out on the stretcher. Every time he woke, the line for the beds seemed longer.
Clement Glubtupuswhe never saw the inside of the aid post. The medics changed his dressings on the stretcher until the wound closed. He is back on the line.
Clement Glubtupuswhe watched a woman sweep her doorstep. He had forgotten that dirt could be removed permanently from anywhere.
Clement Glubtupuswhe and Rafael "Hollow" Red found a cat in the ruins at the Ossuary Wood and argued for an hour about its name. The cat settled it by sleeping on Hollow.
The village shop had three kinds of soap. Clement Glubtupuswhe stood at the counter far longer than the purchase required.
Clement Glubtupuswhe began a chess game by post with a friend at home. He copied the opening move onto the corner of an ordinary letter.
hughsim1: On Day 9 Bastian Hughsim took a post at S-C4 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He whistles the same four notes over and over, and the men liked him for it.
Bastian Hughsim walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Edmund Fedakidd of the Concord lost a cap on a night patrol near Verdel Ridge. Bastian Hughsim of the Hegemony found it in the morning and now wears it on Sundays. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Bastian Hughsim answered to number 834. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Bastian Hughsim watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Bastian Hughsim had orders to attack at dawn. He wrote back asking for artillery first. The orders were cancelled. Nobody knows which of his words did it.
Bastian Hughsim studied the trench map until the candle died, then walked S-C4 in the dark to learn it by heart.
The wind carried away the last words of every order. Bastian Hughsim waited until the corporal came closer before picking up anything heavy.
Bastian Hughsim and Bastian "Rabbit" Cuba carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle.
Bastian Hughsim and Gustav Chongo share one pair of good gloves on watch, one glove each. It is not practical. It is friendship.
A report called the trench satisfactory. Bastian Hughsim invited the author to spend a night in it before signing.
jake_the_snake6424: Clement Snake told the sergeant he was a shepherd. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.
Clement Snake bought a small phrasebook from a passing soldier. The first useful sentence appears after six pages about hiring a carriage.

A clear shot from R-F6. Clement Snake grazed Norbert Sharky and slid back down below the parapet. The salvo walked along R-F6 and caught Clement Snake in the open. Two men carried him back between salvos.

Clement Snake spent the day on a stretcher outside the aid post, waiting for a bed to come free. The bearers brought water twice. On Day 6, Hill 304 passed to the Hegemony. Clement Snake wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Clement Snake never saw the inside of the aid post. The medics changed his dressings on the stretcher until the wound closed. He is back on the line.
Clement Snake practised asking for bread in the local language. The dugout supplied an audience and several confidently incorrect pronunciations.
A bullet hit the sandbag next to Clement Snake's ear at R-F6 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Ivo Joha of the Concord (@joha123477).
Clement Snake no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at R-F6 changed before the cheering ended. Clement Snake shouldered another load.

Somebody across the wire was singing. Then Nils Antonioo stood up to sing louder, and Clement Snake fired. Nils Antonioo was grazed. The singing stopped. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Clement Snake answered to number 206. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Clement Snake folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

A bullet went into Clement Snake's chest just under the heart at R-F6. The medic said not to give him water, and then said nothing more. Shot by Zeno "Button" Joha of the Concord (@joha123477). Clement Snake was killed outright at R-F6, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Zeno "Button" Joha of the Concord (@joha123477).
Benedikt Snake asked about Clement Snake on arriving at R-F6. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.
Benedikt Snake traded a cigarette for a pinch of salt. Supper improved. The argument about the exchange rate did not.
Benedikt Snake and Dietrich Linningorchi tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco.
Benedikt Snake fired one burst and pulled the gun down before the reply came. The reply hit empty sandbags. Wendel "Whistle" Tkendrick did not get to reply at all, grazed.
Benedikt Snake had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Isidor "Mole" Raptor was badly wounded.
The water jacket hissed as Benedikt Snake fired across no man's land. When the gun went quiet, Casimir "Mud" Kjoj was grazed.
jarm_the_warm: Leopold "Ghost" Warm arrived with the evening ration party, carrying his brother's pocket watch and a borrowed coat two sizes too big. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In V-F15, Leopold "Ghost" Warm listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
The company barber offered a choice of haircuts. Leopold "Ghost" Warm asked to see the second one. The barber laughed.
Leopold "Ghost" Warm wrote a letter for Rafael Notrealdi's mother, because Rafael could not find the words. Rafael signed it.
Leopold "Ghost" Warm of the Concord and Nils Noaskevitch of the Hegemony watched a broken branch near Verdel Ridge all morning. Neither could risk assuming it was only a branch.
Leopold "Ghost" Warm had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Gustav Thedanlyfe crossed it, Leopold "Ghost" Warm fired. Gustav Thedanlyfe was gravely wounded.

At V-F15 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Leopold "Ghost" Warm turned around and took a shovel blow. Wendel Sleepyfive of the Hegemony was already gone. Raider: Wendel Sleepyfive of the Hegemony (@sleepyfive.3).
Leopold "Ghost" Warm stopped talking around midday. The medic took one look and called for a stretcher.
kazyutheavali: On Day 9 Hugo Kazyutheaval took a post at R-R5 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He keeps feeding the rats, and the men liked him for it.

Hugo Kazyutheaval walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir. A letter from home found Hugo Kazyutheaval before the night shift. Hugo Kazyutheaval folded it small and kept it close.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Hugo Kazyutheaval's ear at R-R5 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Viktor Thompson of the Concord (@zach.thompson_74). The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Hugo Kazyutheaval did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Back on the fire step at R-R5. Hugo Kazyutheaval says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign.
Hugo Kazyutheaval brushed dried mud off a letter and found one more word under it: 'soon'. He wished the rest of the sentence had survived.
Hugo Kazyutheaval carried hot tea up to the front line in petrol cans. Everyone could taste the petrol. Everyone drank it.
A round came through the loophole Hugo Kazyutheaval was watching at R-R5 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Lucien Kattawar of the Concord (@max.kattawar).
Hugo Kazyutheaval asked the bearers for water and then for his mother. He died before either came.
Karel Kazyutheaval asked about Hugo Kazyutheaval on arriving at R-R5. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.
Karel Kazyutheaval and Hugo "Lucky" Ayangd found a cat in the ruins at Verdel Ridge and argued for an hour about its name. The cat settled it by sleeping on Lucky.
martinsatalik: At the depot, Severin Martinsatali had practised answering to his name. At S-F7, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.
Word came down the line: Verdel Ridge is ours. Severin Martinsatali shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Severin Martinsatali washed his face and someone asked if headquarters was visiting. Apparently being clean needs an explanation.
A flare lit Sorrow Copse like noon. Severin Martinsatali counted the seconds until darkness: eleven.

A rat has started sitting on the ammunition box next to Severin Martinsatali's bunk. He has named it Captain. After the loss of Hill 304, Severin Martinsatali helped stack spare sandbags at S-F7. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-F7 and grazed Severin Martinsatali's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Felix "Parson" Brendanm of the Hegemony (@brendanm_4).
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Severin Martinsatali is whole again, or near enough for the line.
Captain the rat now waits for Severin Martinsatali at dawn watch every morning. He shares crumbs with it. The corporal calls this desertion of rations.
Severin Martinsatali sorted the dressings by lamplight. When the next stretcher arrived, he could find everything without looking.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Severin Martinsatali was hit hard in the fight at S-F7 before anyone could fire. The raider was Casimir "Rabbit" Murilmoore of the Hegemony. Raider: Casimir "Rabbit" Murilmoore of the Hegemony (@murilmoore.06). The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into S-F7. Severin Martinsatali has learned to walk bent double.

Three days with a bandage, and Severin Martinsatali is back at S-F7. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Severin Martinsatali answered to number 150. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Severin Martinsatali watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Captain ran squealing out of the dugout at three in the morning. Severin Martinsatali followed, cursing, seconds before a shell came through the roof. He owes Captain his life.
Severin Martinsatali has not seen Captain for two days. He tells everyone rats come and go. He still leaves crumbs on the box.
A loose strip of canvas snapped above Severin Martinsatali's bunk. He tied it down and received thanks from six apparently sleeping men.
Severin Martinsatali carried in Pip, who lied about his age to enlist. Pip kept asking whether his mother would be told.

The Hegemony raiders came over at S-F7 in the middle of the night. Severin Martinsatali met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Quentin Vicious of the Hegemony (@darth._.vicious).
The papers say Clement "Lucky" Martinsatali. The sergeant says he has his older brother's eyes. Severin Martinsatali's eyes. Nobody in S-F7 argues.
Clement "Lucky" Martinsatali began a chess game by post with a friend at home. He copied the opening move onto the corner of an ordinary letter.
mclainkirkley9: On the way to M-F18, Konrad Mclainkirkle tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way. The transfer made Konrad Mclainkirkle a sniper. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.

New laces made Konrad Mclainkirkle's boots look almost respectable, until he stood up. Konrad Mclainkirkle read the letter out loud to the squad, skipping the private parts. The men asked to hear it again.
mxnorx.x: Ivo Mxnorx arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a pocket Bible with a hole in it and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.
Ivo Mxnorx brought back a wounded man and a lost machine gun from Blackwater Canal in one trip. He is Lance Corporal now.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. Ivo Mxnorx tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at V-F15 is up.
Ivo Mxnorx offered a biscuit for a better place near the stove. The offer was refused with surprising dignity.

Ivo Mxnorx came back from the night raid on two stretcher poles. Nobody is sure which side fired the shot. The bearers set Ivo Mxnorx's stretcher down under a tarp and promised to come back. They came back with another man. Ivo Mxnorx kept the new letter in a breast pocket all day, and touched the pocket now and then to check it was there.

Ivo Mxnorx spent the day on a stretcher outside the aid post, waiting for a bed to come free. The bearers brought water twice. There was a letter for Ivo Mxnorx. Someone at home had drawn a small picture in the corner. Ivo Mxnorx laughed for the first time in days.
nate.boydd: Hugo Boydd was a tram conductor in Lindenbruck until the posters went up. He came to T-F1 with a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts, and within a day the whole squad knew that he keeps feeding the rats.

The mud froze hard overnight. For one morning Hugo Boydd could walk on top of it, like a man walking on water. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Hugo Boydd watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Hugo Boydd won his boots at cards from a lance corporal in T-F1. The lance corporal wants a rematch.
Hugo Boydd came off watch and could not say whether the last hour had felt long or short. He remembered every move in one patch of wire.
A football came over the parapet from the Concord side with Pavel "Brick" Freek's name scratched on it. Hugo Boydd kicked it back. It did not come again.
Rematch. Hugo Boydd lost everything he won, plus a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts. The whole dugout watched.
Hugo Boydd brushed dried mud off a letter and found one more word under it: 'soon'. He wished the rest of the sentence had survived.
Third game, by candlelight, with the shelling for a clock. Hugo Boydd won back a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts and nothing else. He says that was all he was playing for.
noel_cocac: Jakub "Ash" Cocac reached S-F17 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine. Victory at Verdel Ridge. Jakub "Ash" Cocac let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Jakub "Ash" Cocac and Bram Archiegregor made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it.
A loose thread in Jakub "Ash" Cocac's blanket turned out to be very long. By the time he stopped pulling, there was a hole to explain.

The cook asked for an honest opinion of the stew. Jakub "Ash" Cocac asked if second helpings depended on the answer. The sergeant read out the order: Hill 304 has fallen, hold the line. Jakub "Ash" Cocac looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
A bullet went through Jakub "Ash" Cocac's sleeve at S-F17 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Tobias Hellcat of the Hegemony (@hellcat34106).

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Jakub "Ash" Cocac in the open at S-F17. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Emil Theramblingb of the Hegemony (@theramblingbot). Jakub "Ash" Cocac looked over the parapet at S-F17 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Emil Theramblingb of the Hegemony (@theramblingbot).
Ulrich "Bones" Cocac put a lock of hair in a matchbox beside the bunk. Someone who had known Jakub "Ash" Cocac helped clear the shelf without saying why.
A story about a goat passed through three dugouts and reached Ulrich "Bones" Cocac as a story about a general. The ending was the same.
Ulrich "Bones" Cocac tried to describe the smell of Varenne and got as far as the bakery. Then the ration cart arrived.

The raid hit the Hegemony line at the darkest hour. Ulrich "Bones" Cocac fought Rafael "Saint" Ogwanga in a trench no wider than a door. Ulrich "Bones" Cocac came home with Rafael "Saint" Ogwanga's cap badge. (@filip_ogwanga) Ulrich "Bones" Cocac jumped into the Hegemony trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Oskar "Spark" Person. The Hegemony medics will be busy. (@local_distinguished_person) Ulrich "Bones" Cocac was on the dawn watch at S-F17 when the Hegemony raiders came. A club, a shout, and Ulrich "Bones" Cocac was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Oskar Rykerfallion of the Hegemony (@rykerfallion). News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached S-F17 with the rations. Ulrich "Bones" Cocac ate while listening to the revised orders.

The medic looked at Ulrich "Bones" Cocac's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to S-F17. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows. The clerk counted the names twice. Ulrich "Bones" Cocac is number 185 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill is lost. Ulrich "Bones" Cocac heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Ulrich "Bones" Cocac of the Concord and Teodor Ipsumetproal of the Hegemony share the same habit: a whistle at midnight. Both lines at the Ossuary Wood now wait for it before they sleep.
A rat has started sitting on the ammunition box next to Ulrich "Bones" Cocac's bunk. He has named it Duchess.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. Ulrich "Bones" Cocac tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at N-F7 is up.
Duchess the rat now waits for Ulrich "Bones" Cocac at dawn watch every morning. He shares crumbs with it. The corporal calls this desertion of rations.
Duchess ran squealing out of the dugout at three in the morning. Ulrich "Bones" Cocac followed, cursing, seconds before a shell came through the roof. He owes Duchess his life.
Ulrich "Bones" Cocac brushed dried mud off a letter and found one more word under it: 'soon'. He wished the rest of the sentence had survived.
notjona2010: Jonas Notjona reported to R-C14 with a tin of tobacco sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Jonas Notjona shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

A loose thread in Jonas Notjona's blanket turned out to be very long. By the time he stopped pulling, there was a hole to explain. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Jonas Notjona is number 908. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Jonas Notjona could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Jonas Notjona ended a letter with 'nothing to report', then added half a page about the missing soap.
A rat has started sitting on the ammunition box next to Jonas Notjona's bunk. He has named it Captain.
Jonas Notjona ran a message through the communication trench under shellfire. The message said: 'Hold.'
Captain the rat now waits for Jonas Notjona at dawn watch every morning. He shares crumbs with it. The corporal calls this desertion of rations.
Jonas Notjona ran six messages in one night. The last one was a request for more runners.
Jonas Notjona took the long way round Calvary Farm because the short way had a sniper on it. The long way had two.
ph0enix_knight: Albin "Doc" Knight, a postman from Oakmere, was sent forward on Day 17 to fill a gap in V-F1. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
provadabro: Quentin "Ash" Provadabro reported to S-C11 with a pressed cornflower sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.

Quentin "Ash" Provadabro had just lit a cigarette at S-C11 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Otto Sonofadeadme of the Hegemony (@sonofadeadmeme). After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Quentin "Ash" Provadabro helped stack spare sandbags at S-C11. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Quentin "Ash" Provadabro is whole again, or near enough for the line. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Quentin "Ash" Provadabro answered to number 622. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Quentin "Ash" Provadabro watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Quentin "Ash" Provadabro cleaned the gun for the fourth time today. The gun is the only thing in the trench that is kept dry.
Quentin "Ash" Provadabro took stock of his pockets: string, crumbs, a pencil and no sign of the button he was looking for.

At S-C11 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Quentin "Ash" Provadabro won the bet. Zeno Matteozrybak was badly wounded. A trench mortar bomb landed in the next section of trench. The blast caught Quentin "Ash" Provadabro at S-C11 and the bearers came at a run.
Quentin "Ash" Provadabro lay on the stretcher and listened to the surgeon working inside. He tried not to guess what each sound meant.
Quentin "Ash" Provadabro returned to S-C11 thinner and paler, with a wound that closed without a single night in a bed. The medics count it as one of theirs.
Two shots, one miss. The second found Bastian Fly, badly wounded. Quentin "Ash" Provadabro cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not.
rahmat_nasrul21: Zeno Nasrul joined the replacements on Day 10. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.

Zeno Nasrul got a photo of the family house. He spent longer looking at the strange curtains than at the faces. Mail came up the line with a letter for Zeno Nasrul. Zeno Nasrul read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Zeno Nasrul watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
The cook borrowed Zeno Nasrul's mug to measure flour. Getting it back involved waiting for the dough, the baking and the cook's memory.
Zeno Nasrul tried to write neatly for the first line of a letter. By the third, he was writing as quickly as the thoughts arrived.

Zeno Nasrul was buried by a near miss at Blackwater Canal and dug out with a broken arm and a chest full of earth. Mail came up the line with a letter for Zeno Nasrul. Zeno Nasrul read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Zeno Nasrul lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk.

A medic stopped by Zeno Nasrul's stretcher every few hours for a week. Today the medic found it empty. Zeno Nasrul had gone back to P-F11. Zeno Nasrul read the letter out loud to the squad, skipping the private parts. The men asked to hear it again.
Zeno Nasrul failed to return from the wire. A search found tracks leading into churned ground and nothing certain beyond it.
tam_o.banter: Emil Banter, a tram conductor from Brennmoor, was sent forward on Day 12 to fill a gap in N-F13. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
A round went through the rim of Emil Banter's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Gideon Senpai of the Concord (@emelryk_senpai).
Emil Banter no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt. A letter from home reached Emil Banter before dusk. Emil Banter read it twice and slept a little easier.

Emil Banter and Rafael "Lucky" Jack spent an hour hunting rats with a bucket and a piece of cheese. Score at dusk: rats 4, soldiers 1. A letter from home reached Emil Banter before dusk. Emil Banter read it twice and slept a little easier.

Emil Banter went over with the raiders and dropped into the Concord trench. Hugo "Shadow" Brentensg was hit hard before the whistle called everyone back. (@brentensg) Emil Banter came back from the night raid on two stretcher poles. Nobody is sure which side fired the shot. Emil Banter waited two nights for a bed. On the third, a bed came free, but Emil Banter no longer needed it.
Leopold Banter arrived carrying the family name of Emil Banter. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
Leopold Banter traded for a better blanket and got a reputation as a sharp dealer. The man who lost it wants a rematch.
tymcalley: On Day 11 Konrad Tymcalley took a post at V-F17 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He never sits with his back to the parapet, and the men liked him for it.
Konrad Tymcalley caught himself counting portions before counting people. He started again.
A pocket watch went along the bench so everyone could set the time. Konrad Tymcalley has no watch, but checked it anyway, just to feel included.
Konrad Tymcalley tried to write neatly for the first line of a letter. By the third, he was writing as quickly as the thoughts arrived.
Someone had labelled the water bucket 'Soup'. Konrad Tymcalley changed it back after lunch, too late to settle the argument.
A replacement turned out to be from Coldwater too. Konrad Tymcalley and the newcomer argued about the same bakery for half the night.
Konrad Tymcalley borrowed a book with three readers already waiting in line. For once, everyone was impatient about something harmless.
urasmrl: On the way to R-S15, Benedikt Urasmrl tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.
Benedikt Urasmrl ended a letter with 'nothing to report', then added half a page about the missing soap.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Benedikt Urasmrl stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

A bullet found Benedikt Urasmrl at R-S15, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Walter Davebowlton of the Hegemony (@davebowlton). A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Benedikt Urasmrl is number 544. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Benedikt Urasmrl looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
Benedikt Urasmrl lay on the stretcher and listened to the surgeon working inside. He tried not to guess what each sound meant.
Benedikt Urasmrl healed on a stretcher under a canvas sheet, with the bearers stepping over him day and night. He thanked each one by name before leaving.
Blast from a trench mortar threw Benedikt Urasmrl against the trench wall at R-S15. Ringing ears, a split lip, and no intention of leaving.
Benedikt Urasmrl's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at R-S15 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on.
New laces made Benedikt Urasmrl's boots look almost respectable, until he stood up.
Benedikt Urasmrl reached up to fix a sandbag at R-S15 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Ivo Hohne of the Hegemony (@shawn_hohne).
vuminhtri260709: Nobody asked Teodor "Brick" Vuminhtri why he came. Nobody in S-F11 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.
Teodor "Brick" Vuminhtri was in the first hundred. The old hands in S-F11 call them 'the early birds', and not always kindly.

Gideon Allistofeari of the Hegemony and Teodor "Brick" Vuminhtri of the Concord watched a broken branch near the Brickworks all morning. Neither side could afford to assume it was only a branch. News that the Concord had taken Verdel Ridge reached Teodor "Brick" Vuminhtri during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Teodor "Brick" Vuminhtri held the mirror while Isidor Jackmdunn shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments.
Teodor "Brick" Vuminhtri of the Concord spotted Tobias Hellcat of the Hegemony repairing a parapet at Calvary Farm. A warning shot stopped the repair on the spot.

A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Teodor "Brick" Vuminhtri. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer. Hill 304 is lost. Teodor "Brick" Vuminhtri heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Teodor "Brick" Vuminhtri lent Oskar Pbscn a pencil. It came back wrapped in a scrap of paper that said 'One good turn'.
Teodor "Brick" Vuminhtri opened a parcel addressed in unfamiliar handwriting. A note inside said the usual writer had hurt a wrist. He read that note first.
Teodor "Brick" Vuminhtri traded for a better blanket and got a reputation as a sharp dealer. The man who lost it wants a rematch.

Teodor "Brick" Vuminhtri was hit in the forearm at S-F11. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Matthias Mihai of the Hegemony (@angel._.mihai). An enemy patrol scattered in front of S-F11. Teodor "Brick" Vuminhtri fired at the last man to run. Gustav "Tin" Jul was grazed.

Teodor "Brick" Vuminhtri's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at S-F11 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Teodor "Brick" Vuminhtri read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

At Blackwater Canal, Teodor "Brick" Vuminhtri of the Concord and Albin "Saint" Aruuki of the Hegemony spent the morning shooting at the same loose sheet of metal. The sheet kept winning. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into S-F11. Teodor "Brick" Vuminhtri has learned to walk bent double.
Teodor "Brick" Vuminhtri cut his hand to the bone on the wire at Verdel Ridge. Iodine, a bandage, and a lecture from the medic.
The wound on Teodor "Brick" Vuminhtri's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter.
Teodor "Brick" Vuminhtri kept a tally of complaints about the tea. The tally ended when somebody asked whether he was volunteering to make it.
A supply man offered Teodor "Brick" Vuminhtri a damaged gramophone in exchange for help unloading. He accepted before asking whether there were any records.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Teodor "Brick" Vuminhtri was hit hard in the fight at S-F11 before anyone could fire. The raider was Yann Duckman of the Hegemony. Raider: Yann Duckman of the Hegemony (@duckman38259).
Teodor "Brick" Vuminhtri returned to S-F11 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part.
wsc.creason: By the time Cyril Creason reached S-R5, the war was 9 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached S-R5 with the rations. Cyril Creason ate while listening to the revised orders.

A bullet grazed Cyril Creason's ribs at S-R5. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Zeno Tonyhuang of the Hegemony (@tonyhuang000). A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Cyril Creason is number 912. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Cyril Creason watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Cyril Creason returned to S-R5 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part.
Cyril Creason and Teodor "Hollow" Jakesg split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair.
A bullet went through Cyril Creason's sleeve at S-R5 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Nils Gregoriousdo of the Hegemony (@gregoriousdonder).
Cyril Creason was hit in the hip at S-R5. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Felix "Parson" Brendanm of the Hegemony (@brendanm_4).
Cyril Creason lay on the stretcher and listened to the surgeon working inside. He tried not to guess what each sound meant.
Cyril Creason survived the wound and the waiting. He is back at S-R5, and still will not talk about the nights outside the aid post.
